body:
CI builds are not intended for distribution (or any use except testing), so this will only increase download size without any benefits. You can always use `lipo` to extract specific architecture from the universal binary.

For the exports we can include an option to remove specific architecture, but not sure if there's any point to do so, for at least three and a half years Intel macs still have support from Apple (next release in September + 3 years of updates for macOS 26). So every new app is expected to be universal.
